items.title: Voters deliver "AI earthquake," rebuking tech and billionaires
items.summary:
AI had its "official debut" as the biggest issue in American politics, former New York Assemblymember and RAISE Act author Alex Bores told Axios. "AI is reaching into every part of our society and economy and it's now crystal clear it's impacting every part of our politics, too." [...] Voters showed deep distrust of the AI race Tuesday, approving dozens of data center moratoriums and electing a raft of candidates who favor slowing a $10 trillion buildout, including in Texas — the epicenter of the boom.

Why it matters: In an election that hinged on an affordability crisis for many Americans, voters made it clear they view Silicon Valley's AI ambitions not as a technological miracle, but as a resource-draining threat to their wallets and communities. [...] Democratic challengers successfully weaponized AI policy, ousting Republicans in Ohio, Wisconsin, Arizona and Pennsylvania.
   Democratic groups had poured ads into these districts attacking GOP incumbents for a 2025 vote that would've neutered state AI legislation.
   AI safety advocates won or were poised to win races on Tuesday that will expand their coalition in the new Congress, including Colorado's Manny Rutinel and Minnesota's Matt Little.

The new approach, known as FLEX, could lead to more intuitive, interactive household and assistive robots.

Because it learns the underlying dynamics rather than being programmed with an equation, the model can adapt to materials, forces, and environments it never encountered during training.

### Tóm tắt về Mô hình ngôn ngữ lớn (Large Language Model - LLM)

Mô hình ngôn ngữ lớn (LLM) là một loại mô hình học máy, thường là mạng nơ-ron, được đào tạo trên một lượng lớn văn bản để thực hiện các nhiệm vụ xử lý ngôn ngữ tự nhiên, đặc biệt là tạo ngôn ngữ. LLM có khả năng tạo ra, tóm tắt, dịch và phân tích văn bản trong nhiều ngữ cảnh khác nhau. Chúng là nền tảng cho nhiều chatbot hiện đại như ChatGPT, Claude, và Gemini.

LLM thường dựa trên kiến trúc mạng nơ-ron transformer. Các mô hình như Generative Pre-trained Transformers (GPT) là một loại LLM được đào tạo trước để dự đoán từ tiếp theo và thường được tinh chỉnh để tuân theo hướng dẫn và hoạt động như trợ lý.

Tuy nhiên, dữ liệu đào tạo thiên lệch hoặc không chính xác có thể làm giảm độ tin cậy của đầu ra từ LLM. Các đánh giá chuẩn cho LLM cố gắng đo lường khả năng lý luận, độ chính xác thực tế, sự phù hợp và an toàn của mô hình.

Bạn có thể tìm hiểu thêm chi tiết tại [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model).

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Type of machine learning model

"LLM" redirects here. For other uses, see [LLM (disambiguation)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LLM_(disambiguation) "LLM (disambiguation)").

[![](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/81/The_number_of_publications_about_Large_Language_Models_by_year.png/250px-The_number_of_publications_about_Large_Language_Models_by_year.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:The_number_of_publications_about_Large_Language_Models_by_year.png) The number of publications about large language models by year grouped by publication types

A **large language model** ( **LLM**) is a [machine learning model](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine_learning#Models "Machine learning") (typically a [neural network](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neural_network_(machine_learning) "Neural network (machine learning)")) trained on a vast amount of text for [natural language processing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natural_language_processing "Natural language processing") tasks, especially [language generation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Language_generation "Language generation"). LLMs can typically generate, summarize, translate, and analyze text in many contexts.[\[1\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model#cite_note-few-shot-learners2-1) They are the basis for many modern [chatbots](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chatbot "Chatbot"), such as [ChatGPT](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ChatGPT "ChatGPT"), [Claude](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claude_(AI) "Claude (AI)"), [Vibe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mistral_Vibe "Mistral Vibe"), [Gemini](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Google_Gemini "Google Gemini"), [Grok](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grok_(chatbot) "Grok (chatbot)"), [Qwen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qwen "Qwen") and [DeepSeek](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DeepSeek_(chatbot) "DeepSeek (chatbot)").

LLMs are typically based on the [transformer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer_(deep_learning) "Transformer (deep learning)") neural network architecture.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model#cite_note-2) [Generative pre-trained transformers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Generative_pre-trained_transformer "Generative pre-trained transformer") (GPTs) are a type of LLM that is pre-trained to predict the next word.[\[3\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model#cite_note-Wolfram-2023-3) GPTs are then often [fine-tuned](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fine-tuning_(deep_learning) "Fine-tuning (deep learning)") to follow instructions and to behave as assistants.[\[4\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model#cite_note-4)

Biased or inaccurate training data can make an LLM's output less reliable. A [software harness](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agent_harness "Agent harness") can provide LLMs with memory and access to tools such as web search. [Benchmark](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Language_model_benchmark "Language model benchmark") evaluations for LLMs attempt to measure [model reasoning](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reasoning_model "Reasoning model"), factual accuracy, [alignment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AI_alignment "AI alignment"), and [safety](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AI_safety "AI safety").
